title: merged
description: A pull request for the issue was merged. Written by callum-flow-merge on the device that merged it, by the loop when it finds a merge that no merged event recorded, or by callum-flow-sweep (actor sweep) when it finds a merge that no event recorded: one on the issue's branch, or a merged pull request to the default branch that no merged event names by pr (logged as a hand merge, recovered, with the issue only when the pull request's author is trusted and it closes one). Ends the claim; the end point of lead time and throughput. Count one per pr and head. A reader places and ages a merge by coalesce(merged_at, ts), because ts is when the event was written, which for a recovered merge is later than the merge; merged.title is a fallback to the ready/claimed title.

pr.description: The merged pull request; null when the loop found a merge it cannot name.

head.description: The commit that was merged, when known.

by.description: factory: the factory merged it; hand: a person merged it outside the factory.

recovered.description: true when the loop or the sweep logged it afterwards because no merged event was recorded at the merge.

files.description: The repo-relative paths the merged pull request changed, taken from GitHub's pull request files at merge time. Complete up to GitHub's own cap on that list. null when unknown, for example a pr of null or a size that could not be read. A recovered merge can carry it, read when the event was logged.

file_lines.description: The pull request's per-file line counts ({path, additions, deletions}) from GitHub's pull request files at merge time, in the same order as files and up to the same cap. An entry whose counts are not non-negative integers is left out here but still counts in files. null when unknown.

additions.description: The pull request's total lines added, as GitHub reports them at merge time. null when unknown.

deletions.description: The pull request's total lines deleted, as GitHub reports them at merge time. null when unknown.

merged_at.description: When GitHub says the pull request merged (its mergedAt, copied as given). null when unknown.

title.description: The closed issue's title when the event has an issue and its author is trusted, otherwise the pull request's title when its author is trusted, clipped to 256 characters. null when neither was read.
